senses.en: to change a book or play for film or television
senses.pattern: adapt a novel for television / be adapted from / be adapted into a film
senses.example: The best-selling novel was [[adapted]] for television and became the most-watched drama of the year.
senses.example_zh: 這本暢銷小說被改編成電視劇，成為當年收視率最高的戲劇。

senses.en: to change something to suit a new use
senses.pattern: adapt a room for / be adapted for use / specially adapted
senses.example: The old school bus has been [[adapted]] to serve as a mobile library for children in mountain villages.
senses.example_zh: 這輛舊校車已被改裝成行動圖書館，服務山區村落的孩子。

gsat.sentence: The movie director [[adapted]] this year’s bestseller into a hit and made a fortune.
He saw no reason why this could not be [[adapted]] for use on the busy London intersections.

senses.en: to be the same as or equal to something
senses.pattern: amount to cheating / amount to a refusal / amount to the same thing
senses.example: Copying a classmate's homework and handing it in as your own [[amounts]] to cheating.
senses.example_zh: 抄同學的作業再當成自己的交出去，就等同於作弊。

senses.en: to add up to a particular total
senses.pattern: amount to a total of / amount to millions / amount to very little
senses.example: Donations from students and parents [[amounted]] to nearly two million dollars by the end of the charity fair.
senses.example_zh: 到義賣會結束時，學生和家長的捐款總計達將近兩百萬元。

senses.en: special care or treatment given to someone or something
senses.pattern: medical attention / need urgent attention / care and attention
senses.example: The injured hiker needed immediate medical [[attention]], so the rescue team flew him to the nearest hospital.
senses.example_zh: 受傷的登山客需要立刻接受治療，搜救隊於是將他空運到最近的醫院。

senses.en: a position of standing straight and still, as soldiers do
senses.pattern: stand at attention / come to attention / stand to attention
senses.example: The young soldiers stood at [[attention]] as the general walked slowly down the line.
senses.example_zh: 將軍沿著隊伍緩緩走過時，年輕的士兵們都以立正姿勢站好。

gsat.sentence: A new relationship is like an embryo that requires time, care and [[attention]] to grow into whatever may evolve.

senses.en: being the cause of or explanation for something
senses.pattern: the reason behind / the idea behind / the story behind / be behind the attack
senses.example: Scientists are still trying to find out what is [[behind]] the sudden drop in the bee population.
senses.example_zh: 科學家仍在設法查明蜜蜂數量驟減背後的原因。

senses.en: supporting a person, idea, or plan
senses.pattern: be right behind sb / get behind a plan / be fully behind
senses.example: Whatever you decide to study at university, remember that your family is fully [[behind]] you.
senses.example_zh: 不論你決定在大學念什麼，要記得家人都全力支持你。

gsat.sentence: The theory [[behind]] the questionnaire used in the Dognition test.
There is a story [[behind]] how it was first made.

senses.en: to describe someone unfairly as something bad
senses.pattern: be branded a liar / brand sb as a troublemaker / be branded a failure
senses.example: After failing one important test, the boy was unfairly [[branded]] a lazy student by some of his teachers.
senses.example_zh: 一次重要考試不及格後，那個男孩就被一些老師不公平地貼上懶惰學生的標籤。

senses.en: to mark an animal with a hot iron
senses.pattern: brand cattle / brand a calf / be branded with a mark
senses.example: In the past, ranchers [[branded]] their cattle with a hot iron to show who owned them.
senses.example_zh: 從前牧場主人會用燒紅的鐵在牛身上打烙印，以表明牛是誰的。

senses.en: a matter investigated by police or decided in court
senses.pattern: a court case / a murder case / win a case / work on a case
senses.example: Police have reopened the [[case]] of the missing painting after a new witness came forward.
senses.example_zh: 新的目擊者出面後，警方已重新調查那幅畫作失蹤的案件。

senses.en: an instance of a disease or a person having it
senses.pattern: a case of flu / confirmed cases / a severe case / new cases
senses.example: Health officials reported over three hundred new [[cases]] of dengue fever in the south last week.
senses.example_zh: 衛生官員通報，上週南部新增三百多起登革熱病例。

senses.en: a set of reasons for or against something
senses.pattern: make a case for / a strong case / the case against
senses.example: The students made a strong [[case]] for starting school an hour later, citing research on teenagers' sleep.
senses.example_zh: 學生們引用青少年睡眠的研究，為延後一小時上課提出有力的論據。

gsat.sentence: In making a [[case]] for or against zoos, both sides argue that they’re saving animals.
In 1993, the Metropolitan Museum of Art reluctantly handed over 363 pieces of gold, silver, precious stones, paintings, and sculptures back to Turkey after a court [[case]].

senses.en: a tiny piece of silicon holding electronic circuits
senses.pattern: a computer chip / a silicon chip / a chip maker
senses.example: A tiny [[chip]] placed under the dog's skin helps shelters return lost pets to their owners.
senses.example_zh: 植入狗皮下的微小晶片，能幫助收容所把走失的寵物送回飼主身邊。

senses.en: a token used in gambling, or an advantage in bargaining
senses.pattern: a bargaining chip / poker chips / a stack of chips
senses.example: The union used the planned strike as a bargaining [[chip]] to win better pay for its workers.
senses.example_zh: 工會把預定的罷工當作談判籌碼，為勞工爭取更好的薪資。

senses.en: to break a small piece off something hard
senses.pattern: chip a tooth / chip off / a chipped cup
senses.example: Be careful with those plates; the edges [[chip]] easily if you knock them against the sink.
senses.example_zh: 拿那些盤子要小心，邊緣一撞到水槽就很容易碰出缺口。

gsat.sentence: The junk varies from tiny pieces of paint [[chipped]] off rockets to cameras, huge fuel tanks, and even odd items like the million-dollar tool kit that astronaut Heidemarie Stefanyshyn-Piper lost during a spacewalk.

senses.en: to be sold or available in a particular form
senses.pattern: come in three sizes / come in many colors / come with a warranty
senses.example: These running shoes [[come]] in five colors, but only the black pair is available in my size.
senses.example_zh: 這款跑鞋有五種顏色可選，但只有黑色那雙有我的尺寸。

senses.en: to gradually begin to think or feel something
senses.pattern: come to realize / come to believe / come to be known as
senses.example: After living abroad for a year, Mia [[came]] to appreciate the small comforts of her hometown.
senses.example_zh: 在國外住了一年後，米亞逐漸懂得珍惜家鄉那些小小的舒適。
senses.note: come to 後接原形動詞

gsat.sentence: Today, spiral staircases [[come]] in a wide variety of materials: steel, wood, concrete, and recently even glass.
We have [[come]] to believe that storytelling is just for children.

senses.en: a person's general health and physical strength
senses.pattern: a strong constitution / a weak constitution / a delicate constitution
senses.example: The doctor warned that someone with such a delicate [[constitution]] should avoid working night shifts.
senses.example_zh: 醫生提醒，體質這麼虛弱的人應避免上夜班。

senses.en: the way something is formed or made up
senses.pattern: the constitution of the committee / genetic constitution / the constitution of the board
senses.example: Parents questioned the [[constitution]] of the committee, which included no teachers or student representatives at all.
senses.example_zh: 家長質疑該委員會的組成，因為其中完全沒有教師或學生代表。

senses.en: praise for something good that you have done
senses.pattern: take credit for / give sb credit for / deserve credit
senses.example: Although Lena did most of the research, she let the whole group share the [[credit]] for the project.
senses.example_zh: 雖然大部分的研究是莉娜做的，她卻讓全組共享這項專題的功勞。

senses.en: a unit measuring completed study at a college
senses.pattern: earn credits / a three-credit course / credit hours
senses.example: Students must earn at least 128 [[credits]] to graduate from this four-year program.
senses.example_zh: 學生必須修滿至少 128 學分，才能從這個四年制學程畢業。

senses.en: to say someone or something is responsible for an achievement
senses.pattern: credit A to B / be credited with / credit sb with
senses.example: The young nurse was [[credited]] with saving the baby's life by noticing the problem early.
senses.example_zh: 大家把救回寶寶一命歸功於這位及早發現問題的年輕護理師。

gsat.sentence: The team complained that its leader always took the [[credit]] for all the hard work done by the team members.
Most people [[credit]] the first traffic light to Nottingham engineer John Peake Knight.

senses.en: to leave a person or place and not return
senses.pattern: desert one's family / desert one's post / a deserted village
senses.example: Most villagers [[deserted]] the island after the factory closed, leaving only a few elderly fishermen behind.
senses.example_zh: 工廠關閉後，大多數村民都離棄了這座島，只留下幾位年長的漁夫。

gsat.sentence: After years of hard work, Kareem has not only realized his dream but also transformed a piece of [[deserted]] property into a beautiful forest.
Left vacant for years, the [[deserted]] house was filled with a thick coating of dust and a smell of old damp wood.

senses.en: the general meaning of what someone says
senses.pattern: get the drift / catch sb's drift / the general drift of
senses.example: I couldn't understand every word of the French speech, but I got the general [[drift]] of it.
senses.example_zh: 那場法語演講我沒辦法每個字都聽懂，但聽懂了它的大意。

senses.zh: 漫無目的地漂泊；漸漸轉向
senses.en: to move or change gradually without a clear plan
senses.pattern: drift from job to job / drift apart / drift toward
senses.example: Without clear goals, he [[drifted]] from one part-time job to another for several years.
senses.example_zh: 由於沒有明確目標，他好幾年都漫無目的地換過一份又一份兼職。

gsat.sentence: In his early adulthood, he even [[drifted]] toward communism.

senses.en: to arrange something cleverly, often in secret
senses.pattern: engineer a comeback / engineer a meeting / engineer sb's downfall
senses.example: Lily's friends secretly [[engineered]] a meeting between her and the classmate she had quarreled with.
senses.example_zh: 莉莉的朋友暗中策劃了一場會面，讓她和吵過架的同學碰面。

senses.en: to design or change something using scientific methods
senses.pattern: genetically engineered crops / be engineered to do / precisely engineered
senses.example: Scientists have [[engineered]] a new type of rice that can survive long periods of flooding.
senses.example_zh: 科學家已改造出一種能耐受長期淹水的新品種稻米。

gsat.sentence: It looks like a precisely [[engineered]] jigsaw puzzle, each branch growing just perfectly so it almost, but not quite, touches the neighboring tree.

senses.en: a state of not working or functioning properly
senses.pattern: heart failure / engine failure / power failure / kidney failure
senses.example: A sudden power [[failure]] left the whole hospital in darkness until the backup generator started.
senses.example_zh: 突如其來的電力故障讓整間醫院陷入黑暗，直到備用發電機啟動為止。

senses.en: the fact of not doing something expected or required
senses.pattern: failure to do / failure to pay / failure to comply with
senses.example: [[Failure]] to wear a helmet while riding a scooter can result in a heavy fine.
senses.example_zh: 騎機車未戴安全帽，可能會被處以高額罰款。

senses.en: to shoot bullets from a gun
senses.pattern: fire a gun / fire a shot / fire at sb / fire into the air
senses.example: The starter [[fired]] his pistol into the air, and eight runners burst out of the blocks.
senses.example_zh: 發令員朝天開槍，八名跑者隨即衝出起跑架。

senses.en: to make someone feel very excited or interested
senses.pattern: fire sb's imagination / fire sb with enthusiasm / fire sb up
senses.example: The astronaut's talk [[fired]] the students' imagination, and many of them signed up for the science club.
senses.example_zh: 太空人的演講激發了學生的想像力，其中許多人因此報名參加科學社。

senses.en: shots from guns, or strong criticism
senses.pattern: come under fire / be under fire / open fire
senses.example: The company came under [[fire]] for dumping polluted water into the river near the village.
senses.example_zh: 那家公司因把污水排入村莊附近的河流而遭到猛烈抨擊。

gsat.sentence: His powerful images of Yellowstone [[fired]] the imagination of Congress members.

senses.en: to visit a place often
senses.pattern: frequent a café / be frequented by tourists / frequent the library
senses.example: The old bookstore he [[frequented]] as a boy has since been turned into a convenience store.
senses.example_zh: 他小時候常去的那家舊書店，後來已改成便利商店。

senses.en: a pointer on a clock or watch
senses.pattern: the hour hand / the minute hand / the second hand
senses.example: The [[hands]] of the station clock had stopped at 2:46, the moment the earthquake struck.
senses.example_zh: 車站時鐘的指針停在 2 點 46 分，也就是地震發生的那一刻。

senses.en: a worker, especially one doing physical work
senses.pattern: a farm hand / a hired hand / hire extra hands / be short of hands
senses.example: During the harvest season, the orchard hires extra [[hands]] to pick the fruit before it rains.
senses.example_zh: 採收季節時，果園會多雇一些人手，趕在下雨前把水果採完。

senses.en: a round of clapping to show approval
senses.pattern: give sb a big hand / get a big hand
senses.example: Let's give our volunteers a big [[hand]] for cleaning up the beach all morning.
senses.example_zh: 志工們整個早上都在淨灘，讓我們給他們熱烈的掌聲。
senses.note: 此義只用單數：a big hand

senses.en: low in rank or social position
senses.pattern: humble origins / a humble background / of humble birth
senses.example: Born into a [[humble]] family of farmers, she later became the country's most respected judge.
senses.example_zh: 她出身卑微的農家，後來成為該國最受敬重的法官。

senses.en: simple and plain, not large or special
senses.pattern: a humble home / humble beginnings / a humble meal
senses.example: The famous chef started his career at a [[humble]] noodle stand beside the train station.
senses.example_zh: 這位名廚的事業是從火車站旁一個簡陋的麵攤起步的。

gsat.sentence: They often concern very strong or clever people who come from [[humble]] backgrounds.
But the knife had [[humble]] beginnings.

senses.en: a set of musical notes based on one note
senses.pattern: in the key of C / a major key / a minor key / sing off key
senses.example: The song was too high for the choir, so the teacher played it in a lower [[key]].
senses.example_zh: 這首歌對合唱團來說太高了，所以老師改用較低的調來彈。

senses.en: a list of answers or explanations of symbols
senses.pattern: an answer key / a map key / the key to the exercises
senses.example: Check your answers against the [[key]] at the back of the workbook after you finish each exercise.
senses.example_zh: 每做完一個練習，就對照習作後面的解答核對答案。

senses.en: the period during which something lasts or works
senses.pattern: shelf life / battery life / extend the life of
senses.example: Regular cleaning and oiling can double the [[life]] of a bicycle chain.
senses.example_zh: 定期清潔和上油，可以讓腳踏車鏈條的使用壽命加倍。

senses.en: energy, activity, and liveliness
senses.pattern: full of life / come to life / bring sth to life
senses.example: The night market was full of [[life]], with vendors shouting and children running between the stalls.
senses.example_zh: 夜市充滿活力，攤販大聲叫賣，孩子們在攤位間跑來跑去。

senses.en: the punishment of staying in prison until death
senses.pattern: be sentenced to life / get life / life in prison
senses.example: The judge sentenced the man to [[life]] for a crime that had shocked the whole country.
senses.example_zh: 法官因這起震驚全國的罪行，判處該名男子無期徒刑。

gsat.sentence: Moisture and oxygen promote oxidation and therefore limit its shelf [[life]].

senses.en: to advertise and sell a product to the public
senses.pattern: market a product / be marketed as / be marketed to teenagers
senses.example: The drink is [[marketed]] as a healthy choice, though each bottle contains ten cubes of sugar.
senses.example_zh: 這款飲料被當成健康的選擇來行銷，但每瓶其實含有十顆方糖的糖量。

senses.en: the number of people who want to buy something
senses.pattern: a market for / a growing market / a ready market
senses.example: There is a growing [[market]] for electric scooters as more cities limit gas-powered vehicles downtown.
senses.example_zh: 隨著越來越多城市限制燃油車進入市中心，電動機車的需求日益成長。

gsat.sentence: 100% Fish is a big international enterprise [[marketing]] seafood products.
The hula hoop gained international popularity in the late 1950s, when a plastic version was successfully [[marketed]] by California’s Wham-O toy company.

senses.en: fairly small in size, amount, or value
senses.pattern: a modest increase / a modest amount / a modest income / modest growth
senses.example: The company reported only a [[modest]] increase in sales, far below what investors had hoped for.
senses.example_zh: 該公司公布的銷售額只有些微的成長，遠低於投資人的期望。

senses.en: simple and plain, not expensive or showy
senses.pattern: a modest house / a modest lifestyle / a modest meal
senses.example: Despite his great wealth, the writer lived in a [[modest]] apartment with very little furniture.
senses.example_zh: 儘管非常富有，這位作家卻住在一間樸實的公寓裡，家具少之又少。

gsat.sentence: Research shows that [[modest]] amounts of exercise—even just 15 minutes a day—helps ease depression, enhance self-image, relieve stress, and much more.
The prom has changed from a [[modest]] event to a glamorous party over the years.

senses.en: information or a warning given before something happens
senses.pattern: advance notice / at short notice / until further notice / without notice
senses.example: The museum will remain closed until further [[notice]] while workers repair the damaged roof.
senses.example_zh: 工人修復受損屋頂期間，博物館將持續休館，何時重新開放另行通知。

senses.en: a written or printed announcement put in a public place
senses.pattern: put up a notice / a notice on the board / a public notice
senses.example: A [[notice]] on the classroom door said that the math test had been moved to Friday.
senses.example_zh: 教室門上的公告寫著，數學考試已改到星期五。

senses.en: no longer burning or shining
senses.pattern: go out / put out a fire / blow out the candles / the lights are out
senses.example: The campers made sure the fire was completely [[out]] before they went to sleep in their tents.
senses.example_zh: 露營的人確認營火完全熄滅後，才進帳篷睡覺。

senses.en: available for the public to buy or see
senses.pattern: come out / be out now / be out in stores
senses.example: The singer's new album has been [[out]] for only a week, but it already tops the charts.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手的新專輯才問世一週，就已登上排行榜冠軍。

senses.en: to look very carefully, especially when seeing is difficult
senses.pattern: peer at / peer into / peer through / peer over
senses.example: The little girl [[peered]] through the keyhole, trying to see what her parents were wrapping.
senses.example_zh: 小女孩透過鑰匙孔仔細看，想知道爸媽在包什麼東西。

senses.en: to take money for yourself, especially dishonestly
senses.pattern: pocket the money / pocket the difference / pocket the profits
senses.example: The dishonest clerk charged customers extra and [[pocketed]] the difference for nearly a year.
senses.example_zh: 那名不誠實的店員向顧客多收錢，並侵吞差額將近一年。

senses.en: a small area different from what surrounds it
senses.pattern: pockets of poverty / a pocket of air / isolated pockets
senses.example: Most of the city has recovered from the flood, but small [[pockets]] of damage remain near the river.
senses.example_zh: 城市大部分地區已從水災中復原，但河邊仍有零星受損的小區域。

senses.en: a group of lions living together
senses.pattern: a pride of lions / the leader of the pride
senses.example: From the jeep we watched a [[pride]] of lions resting in the shade of a large tree.
senses.example_zh: 我們從吉普車上看著一個獅群在大樹的樹蔭下休息。

senses.en: to be proud of a quality or skill
senses.pattern: pride oneself on / pride itself on quality
senses.example: The restaurant [[prides]] itself on using only vegetables grown by local farmers.
senses.example_zh: 這家餐廳以只使用在地農夫栽種的蔬菜自豪。
senses.note: 須接反身代名詞再加 on

senses.en: to put pressure on someone to do something
senses.pattern: push sb to do / push sb into / push oneself too hard
senses.example: My parents never [[pushed]] me to become a doctor; they let me choose my own path.
senses.example_zh: 我爸媽從不逼迫我當醫生，他們讓我自己選擇要走的路。

senses.en: a determined effort, or encouragement to do something
senses.pattern: a push for reform / a push to do / give sb a push
senses.example: The city has launched a major [[push]] to reduce plastic waste in night markets.
senses.example_zh: 市政府已展開行動，大力推動夜市減少塑膠垃圾。

gsat.sentence: In everyday situations, too, stress can provide that extra [[push]] needed to do something difficult.

senses.en: waste material that has been thrown away
senses.pattern: household refuse / refuse collection / a refuse dump
senses.example: Trucks carry the town's [[refuse]] to a plant where it is burned to produce electricity.
senses.example_zh: 卡車把鎮上的垃圾運到一座工廠，在那裡焚燒發電。

senses.en: the process of becoming more important, powerful, or popular
senses.pattern: the rise of / the rise and fall of / a rise to power / a rise to fame
senses.example: The [[rise]] of online shopping has forced many small bookstores in the neighborhood to close.
senses.example_zh: 網路購物的興起迫使附近許多小書店關門。

senses.en: to fight against a ruler or government
senses.pattern: rise up against / rise against / rise in revolt
senses.example: In 1789, the hungry people of Paris [[rose]] against the king and changed French history forever.
senses.example_zh: 1789 年，飢餓的巴黎人民起義反抗國王，永遠改變了法國歷史。

gsat.sentence: Paintings with white-toothed smiles emerged after the 1700s, with the gradual [[rise]] of a culture that valued perception and responsiveness.
Such demand increased with the [[rise]] of western movies, and many cowboys with masterful skills on horseback found a new career as a stunt person.

senses.en: to close something tightly or block an entrance
senses.pattern: seal an envelope / seal off the area / a sealed container
senses.example: Put the leftover cookies in a jar and [[seal]] it tightly to keep them crispy.
senses.example_zh: 把吃剩的餅乾放進罐子裡並密封好，以保持酥脆。

senses.en: an official stamp, or something that keeps a container closed
senses.pattern: an official seal / a wax seal / break the seal
senses.example: The letter carried the royal [[seal]], so the guards let the messenger enter the palace at once.
senses.example_zh: 那封信上蓋有皇家印章，所以衛兵立刻讓信差進入王宮。

senses.en: to make an agreement or result certain
senses.pattern: seal a deal / seal a victory / seal sb's fate
senses.example: The two companies [[sealed]] the deal with a handshake after six months of talks.
senses.example_zh: 經過六個月的談判，兩家公司握手敲定了這筆交易。

gsat.sentence: Some waste from nuclear power plants is buried in [[sealed]] containers.
It is said that in ancient times a man would place a drop of blood between his wife’s eyes to [[seal]] their marriage.

senses.en: sudden and large in amount or degree
senses.pattern: a sharp rise / a sharp drop / a sharp increase / a sharp decline
senses.example: Farmers are worried about the [[sharp]] drop in rainfall over the past three months.
senses.example_zh: 過去三個月降雨量急遽減少，農民十分憂心。

senses.en: exactly at the time mentioned
senses.pattern: at nine o'clock sharp / at 8:30 sharp
senses.example: The school bus leaves at seven o'clock [[sharp]], so don't expect the driver to wait for you.
senses.example_zh: 校車七點整準時開車，所以別指望司機會等你。

senses.en: quick to notice, think, or understand
senses.pattern: a sharp mind / sharp eyes / a sharp sense of smell
senses.example: Even at ninety, my grandfather has a [[sharp]] mind and beats everyone at chess.
senses.example_zh: 我爺爺即使九十歲了，頭腦依然敏銳，下棋誰都贏不了他。

gsat.sentence: In the early 1900s, versions of the British traffic lights appeared in big cities in America, where traffic was on a [[sharp]] rise.
Since the orange trees suffered severe damage from a storm in the summer, the farmers are expecting a [[sharp]] decline in harvests this winter.

senses.en: very small in amount or chance
senses.pattern: a slim chance / slim hopes / a slim margin / a slim majority
senses.example: The home team won by a [[slim]] margin, scoring the only goal in the last minute.
senses.example_zh: 地主隊以微小的差距獲勝，在最後一分鐘踢進全場唯一的一球。

senses.en: a short period of a particular kind of weather or activity
senses.pattern: a cold spell / a dry spell / a spell of rain / a brief spell
senses.example: A brief [[spell]] of rain in the afternoon cooled the city down after a week of heat.
senses.example_zh: 下午下了短短一段時間的雨，讓熱了一週的城市涼快下來。

senses.en: magic words, or the magical state they cause
senses.pattern: cast a spell on / break the spell / under sb's spell
senses.example: In the story, a witch casts a [[spell]] on the prince and turns him into a frog.
senses.example_zh: 故事裡，女巫對王子施了咒語，把他變成青蛙。

senses.en: to cause or mean something bad
senses.pattern: spell disaster / spell trouble / spell the end of
senses.example: Another month without rain could [[spell]] disaster for the farmers who depend on this river.
senses.example_zh: 再一個月不下雨，對依賴這條河的農民來說可能意味著一場災難。

gsat.sentence: When subjected to repeated pressurization high in the sky, the four corners on a square window may [[spell]] disaster.
Other times, a magician may make you a magic charm, or say a [[spell]], to cure you.

senses.en: to accept or bear something unpleasant
senses.pattern: cannot stomach / hard to stomach / stomach the idea of
senses.example: Rita found it hard to [[stomach]] the rude way the customer spoke to the young waiter.
senses.example_zh: 麗塔覺得很難忍受那位顧客對年輕服務生說話的無禮態度。
senses.note: 多用於否定句或疑問句

senses.en: a legal case brought to a court
senses.pattern: file a suit / bring a suit against / a civil suit
senses.example: Three former workers filed a [[suit]] against the factory, claiming that it had never paid them overtime.
senses.example_zh: 三名前員工對工廠提起訴訟，聲稱工廠從未付過加班費。

senses.en: to be right, convenient, or suitable for someone or something
senses.pattern: suit one's needs / be well suited to / suit sb's taste
senses.example: The quiet seaside town is well [[suited]] to travelers who want to escape crowded tourist spots.
senses.example_zh: 這座寧靜的海濱小鎮很適合想避開擁擠景點的旅客。

gsat.sentence: Is it a good idea to keep animals in sites not [[suited]] to them?
The moral lesson is “First identify your strengths, and then change the playing field to [[suit]] them.”

senses.en: (of food) soft and easy to cut or chew
senses.pattern: tender meat / tender beef / cook until tender / tender and juicy
senses.example: Cook the beef slowly for three hours until it is [[tender]] enough to cut with a spoon.
senses.example_zh: 把牛肉慢燉三小時，直到軟嫩得用湯匙就能切開。

senses.en: painful or sore when touched
senses.pattern: tender to the touch / a tender spot / feel tender / swollen and tender
senses.example: Two days after the fall, his ankle was still swollen and [[tender]] to the touch.
senses.example_zh: 跌倒兩天後，他的腳踝仍然腫脹，而且一碰就痛。

senses.en: to follow the movement or progress of something
senses.pattern: track a package / track the movements of / track down
senses.example: Researchers attach small radio tags to sea turtles to [[track]] their journeys across the Pacific.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員在海龜身上裝小型無線電標籤，以追蹤牠們橫越太平洋的旅程。

senses.en: marks left on the ground by a person, animal, or vehicle
senses.pattern: animal tracks / tire tracks / keep track of / lose track of
senses.example: The hunters followed the bear's [[tracks]] in the snow until they disappeared at the river.
senses.example_zh: 獵人沿著雪地上熊的足跡前進，直到足跡在河邊消失。

gsat.sentence: We haven’t seen John for a long time. As a matter of fact, we have lost [[track]] of him.
Moreover, each visitor is offered the option to wear a GPS Adventure Band, which allows them to keep [[track]] of each other while in the park.

senses.en: a means of expressing or achieving something
senses.pattern: a vehicle for / serve as a vehicle for / a vehicle of expression
senses.example: Social media has become a powerful [[vehicle]] for spreading both news and rumors.
senses.example_zh: 社群媒體已成為傳播新聞與謠言的強大媒介。

senses.en: although; despite the fact that
senses.pattern: While it is true that / While I agree that
senses.example: [[While]] I understand your worries, I still believe the school trip is safe enough for everyone.
senses.example_zh: 雖然我理解你的擔憂，我仍然相信這趟校外教學對大家來說夠安全。
senses.note: 此義的 while 子句多置於句首

senses.en: used to contrast two different facts or situations
senses.pattern: some…, while others… / A is…, while B is…
senses.example: My brother spends his allowance as soon as he gets it, [[while]] I save most of mine.
senses.example_zh: 我哥哥零用錢一拿到就花光，而我則把大部分存起來。

gsat.sentence: [[While]] this oil-absorbing feature might not always be so great for our hygiene, it can be great for the environment.
The straps on the heel and toe control the length of the shoe, [[while]] the two on either side allow for different widths.

quiz.stem: The small café near the harbor is ______ by local artists, who gather there every evening to share ideas and show their latest paintings.
quiz.explain_zh: frequent＝常去、常光顧。當地藝術家每晚都到那家咖啡館聚會。

quiz.stem: Residents complained that piles of household ______ had been left on the sidewalk for days, attracting rats and giving off a terrible smell.
quiz.explain_zh: refuse＝垃圾。家庭垃圾堆在人行道上好幾天，引來老鼠又發臭。

quiz.stem: The vet admitted that the chances of saving the badly injured eagle were ______, but the volunteers refused to give up and fed it every two hours.
quiz.explain_zh: slim＝渺茫的。獸醫坦言救活老鷹的機會渺茫，但志工不放棄。

quiz.stem: Although Mark enjoys most horror movies, he simply cannot ______ scenes in which animals get hurt and always looks away from the screen.
quiz.explain_zh: stomach＝忍受。馬克無法忍受動物受傷的畫面，總會把頭轉開。

quiz.stem: After a two-week cold ______ damaged most of the tea leaves, farmers in the mountains asked the government for financial help.
quiz.explain_zh: spell＝一段時間。持續兩週的寒冷天氣凍壞茶葉，茶農請求補助。

quiz.stem: The scientist ______ her success to her high school chemistry teacher, who had first encouraged her to ask questions and do experiments.
quiz.explain_zh: credit＝把…歸功於。科學家把成功歸功於鼓勵她發問的化學老師。

quiz.stem: Blessed with a strong ______, the 80-year-old farmer rarely catches a cold and still works in the rice fields every day.
quiz.explain_zh: constitution＝體質。老農夫體質強健，很少感冒，仍天天下田。

quiz.stem: The clever coach ______ a surprising victory by quietly changing the team's game plan during the break.
quiz.explain_zh: engineer＝策劃。教練在休息時悄悄改變戰術，策劃出一場意外的勝利。

quiz.stem: ______ the new ticketing app is quick and easy to use, many elderly passengers still prefer to buy their train tickets at the counter.
quiz.explain_zh: while＝雖然。雖然購票程式好用，許多年長乘客仍偏好臨櫃買票。

quiz.stem: For the drama club, the annual school play is more than entertainment; it serves as a ______ for students to express their views on social issues.
quiz.explain_zh: vehicle＝媒介。年度公演不只是娛樂，更是學生表達社會觀點的媒介。
